field.label: Enable MAX
field.help: Send selected system notifications to MAX independently of Telegram and Gotify.

field.label: MAX provider
field.help: Choose the official MAX Bot API or notify.a161.ru. Use the token provided by the selected service.

field.label: MAX access token
field.help: Enter the access token issued by the selected MAX service. It is stored in the OPNsense configuration and hidden in the settings form.

field.label: Recipient type
field.help: Choose personal chat for a user ID, or group/channel for a chat ID. notify.a161.ru uses negative IDs for groups and channels.

field.label: Recipient ID
field.help: Enter the user or chat ID accepted by the selected provider.
